reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes TiC nanoprecipitates will form an interconnected network and act as high-conductivity bridges in a metallic matrix, which contradicts the well-established understanding that ceramic particles are thermal barriers and reduce effective conductivity.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on comparing thermal conductivity and mechanical properties of treated vs. untreated samples under simulated conditions.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamentally flawed mechanism; testing it would waste resources on a prediction that is physically unsound.
